India Rebuffs Pakistan at UN on Terrorism and Nuclear Blackmail

India delivered a strong rebuttal to Pakistan at the UN General Assembly, addressing concerns over terrorism, nuclear proliferation, and regional stability. India stated it would not bow to nuclear blackmail and drew three "red lines" in its response. The Indian delegation's remarks were a direct response to statements made by Pakistan.
